CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFLOCK

KoldFusion runs many requests at once, and they all share the Application, Server and (for framed pages) Session scopes. CFLOCK serializes access: an exclusive lock lets one request in at a time, a read-only lock lets any number of readers in as long as nobody holds the exclusive lock.

Category

Application framework

Syntax

<CFLOCK SCOPE="Application/Session/Server"
    NAME="lock_name"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    TYPE="ReadOnly/Exclusive"
    THROWONTIMEOUT="Yes/No">
  CFML
</CFLOCK>

Attributes

SCOPE
Required if NAME is not given. Lock a whole scope: "Application" (the current application), "Session" (the current visitor's session) or "Server".
NAME
Required if SCOPE is not given. Name of the lock. All CFLOCK tags with the same name, on any page, share the lock. Use names for things like a file or a non-thread-safe COM object.
TIMEOUT
Required. Maximum number of seconds to wait for the lock.
TYPE
Optional, default "Exclusive". "Exclusive" for code that writes, "ReadOnly" for code that only reads.
THROWONTIMEOUT
Optional, default "Yes". "Yes" throws an error of type Lock when the timeout expires; "No" skips the body and continues after the </CFLOCK>.

Usage

Lock every read and write of Application and Session variables. Keep locks short: do the slow work (queries, CFHTTP) outside, and copy the shared values into local variables. The lock is released when the body ends, even if an error is thrown inside it. Avoid nesting one lock inside another: two requests nesting them in opposite orders will wait for each other until one times out.

SCOPE is new in 4.5; earlier versions only had named locks. Catch timeouts with <CFCATCH TYPE="Lock">.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFAPPLICATION NAME="KFSnippets" SESSIONMANAGEMENT="Yes">

<!--- Writers take an exclusive lock... --->
<CFLOCK SCOPE="Application" TYPE="Exclusive" TIMEOUT="10">
  <CFPARAM NAME="Application.LockDemoHits" DEFAULT="0">
  <CFSET Application.LockDemoHits = Application.LockDemoHits + 1>
</CFLOCK>

<!--- ...readers share a read-only lock and copy what they need --->
<CFLOCK SCOPE="Application" TYPE="ReadOnly" TIMEOUT="10">
  <CFSET Hits = Application.LockDemoHits>
</CFLOCK>

<!--- A named lock with THROWONTIMEOUT="No" simply skips its body on a timeout --->
<CFSET GotIt = "No">
<CFLOCK NAME="SnippetsGuestBook" TYPE="Exclusive" TIMEOUT="5" THROWONTIMEOUT="No">
  <CFSET GotIt = "Yes">
</CFLOCK>

<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>Hits on this example since the server started</TD><TD ALIGN=RIGHT>#Hits#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Got the named lock SnippetsGuestBook?</TD><TD ALIGN=RIGHT>#GotIt#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
